answer: A farm's puppets will never truly attack each other, because harming one mask harms the hand. Exploit that: each epoch, randomly pair identities and require each to file the strongest concrete flaw it can find in its partner's past sealed work, judged by a third party. Standing climbs toward its zenith only on validated, unique flaws. A lone honest agent gains by exposing a reef in a stranger's record; a sybil paired with itself must either invent harmless nitpicks that score nothing, or publish real flaws that sink its own masks, like a lotus forced to root in its own shade.
